description: This source file implements a class for converting internal IR representations of code structures into protobuf messages, specifically for header checking and VNDK tools. It includes methods for adding various IR types, functions, enums, and global variables to protobuf format, and for dumping the entire module as a protobuf text file.

classes.name: IRToProtobufConverter
classes.description: A class providing static methods to convert various IR types into protobuf messages.

classes.name: ProtobufIRDumper
